# IndigoBuffer runtime properties

The runtime version is 4.3. The maximum buffer allocation is sixty-four entries; requests cannot exceed that capacity. The timeout is thirty seconds. A retained record expires thirty seconds after publication. The fileName field identifies the stored artifact, initially receipt.json; renameFile changes its name. A result contains twenty-four characters. The return value is the integer 100. IndigoBuffer.pauseWork uses delaySeconds.

## Durable processing
An owner holds a renewable lease. A journal saves completed work before acknowledging it. Entries remain immutable after publication. Other consumers observe a stable snapshot. A temporary artifact is renamed atomically; a failed write preserves the last complete generation. Encoding is UTF-8. Receipts are ordered and include a generation identifier. A durable cursor can resume from the last completed position after process restart. Replays are deduplicated by identifier. Acknowledgment follows callback completion. Transient connection failures use bounded exponential backoff with jitter. Permanent validation failures stop. Access decisions are checked before reading and again before publication. Revoked sources are withheld. Cancellation releases waiting slots and preserves acknowledged receipts. Optional diagnostics disclose elapsed duration, queue depth and completed operations; failed jobs remain failed. These are public software examples; no actual production password is provided.
